Expected Result: "Challenge complete: <Name>" HUD popup + sound fires immediately; the CHALLENGES button appears on the cycle-end screen and its own dialog shows that challenge checked off.

Action: Satisfy every requirement currently assigned to one character
Expected Result: That character's select-screen portrait switches from its normal (or blacked-out, for a "not implemented" character) image to the mod's own "complete" variant -- or, if no custom complete asset exists for that character, falls back to vanilla's own story-ending portrait.
Notes: This is the ONLY in-game visual confirmation for the 6 non-curated requirements (Ending, Outlaw, Food Quest, Quick Broadcast, King, Unique Kills, Visit Shelter) -- they get no HUD popup.

Location: Quit to menu, then reload the same save
Action: Make some gimmick/requirement progress (a few kills, a completed requirement, a partial OneSpear pull count), quit to the main menu, then reload that exact save slot
Expected Result: All of that progress survives the reload exactly as it was -- kill records, completed-requirement markers, and pull counts are unchanged.

Location: Remix menu > Primal, close and reopen
Action: Change a requirement's own setting (e.g. Ending's select, Outlaw's score textbox, one of King's 4 checkboxes), close the Remix menu entirely, then reopen it
Expected Result: The changed value is still there exactly as set -- nothing reverts to its default on reopening.
